text:
# SOP-P1-L1-01 Line startup - Hot Forge line
Revision: Rev B
Plant: P1, line P1-L1
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, EQ-P1-L1-IH03
Related: MM-P1-L1-IH03, SB-1009, SOP-P1-L1-03

Preconditions
1. All preventive maintenance for EQ-P1-L1-IH03 completed per MM-P1-L1-IH03.
2. Safety bulletin SB-1009 reviewed and applicable controls in place.
3. Communication with downstream cell per SOP-P1-L1-03 confirmed.

Required PPE
1. Flame-resistant coveralls.
2. Welder's gloves and impact-resistant sleeves.
3. Face shield plus safety goggles.
4. Hearing protection and steel-toe boots.
5. Heat-resistant gloves for billet handling.

Procedure
1. Visual inspection
   1.1. Verify no foreign material in the furnace area of EQ-P1-L1-IH03 and approach paths to EQ-P1-L1-RR01 and EQ-P1-L1-CN02.
   1.2. Confirm guards and interlocks are engaged.

2. Induction heater preparation (EQ-P1-L1-IH03)
   2.1. Load billet following handling protocol.
   2.2. Set control recipe to target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 1180 °C.
   2.3. Monitor temperature rise; verify alarm thresholds per MM-P1-L1-IH03.

3. Conveyor and ring rolling mill readiness (EQ-P1-L1-CN02, EQ-P1-L1-RR01)
   3.1. Verify conveyor drive and alignment visually.
   3.2. Check mandrel clamp and tooling secure.
   3.3. Confirm the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) is 635 N·m.

4. Functional checks
   4.1. Execute control interlock test sequence.
   4.2. Run a cold pass without billet to confirm motion profiles and emergency stop response.
   4.3. Initiate a monitored heat cycle and perform a first-piece inspection per SOP-P1-L1-03.

5. Startup handover
   5.1. Transfer control to production operator only after all checks pass.
   5.2. Record all readings and anomalies in line log.

Sign-off
Operator signature: ______________________
Printed name: ______________________
Supervisor signature: ______________________
Comments/Nonconformances: ______________________
title: Line startup - Hot Forge line

text:
# SOP-P1-L1-02 Product changeover - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, EQ-P1-L1-IH03

1. Preconditions
   1.1 Verify work order and ECN status per ECN-2026-003.  
   1.2 Confirm machine availability and lockout/tagout complete for EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, EQ-P1-L1-IH03.  
   1.3 Ensure spare tooling and lubricant are staged; lubricant part number for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) is CFW-LUB-508.

2. Personal protective equipment (PPE)
   2.1 Mandatory PPE: safety glasses, heat-resistant gloves, hearing protection, steel-toe footwear, and protective apron.  
   2.2 Additional PPE as required by site safety bulletins SB-1009 and SB-1025.

3. Changeover sequence
   3.1 Isolate energy following site lockout/tagout procedure referenced in ECN-2026-003.  
   3.2 Remove product-specific tooling from EQ-P1-L1-RR01 and EQ-P1-L1-CN02. Clean and inspect fixtures; repair or replace per maintenance procedure.  
   3.3 Install new tooling and fixtures. Tighten mandrel clamp bolt on Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) to specified setting: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) is 635 N·m. Record verification in the changeover log.  
   3.4 Replenish lubricant on EQ-P1-L1-CN02 using lubricant part number CFW-LUB-508. Log batch/lot information as required.  
   3.5 Restore energy and perform dry-run verification at low feed rates to confirm alignment, clamping, and sensing. Confirm no interference or alarm conditions.  
   3.6 Execute first-piece inspection and dimensional verification. Hold first-piece until quality acceptance.

4. Documentation and references
   4.1 Complete changeover checklist and attach to job traveler.  
   4.2 Refer to ECN-2026-003, SB-1009, SB-1025 for engineering and safety clarifications.

5. Sign-off
   5.1 Operator name and signature: ______________________  
   5.2 Shift supervisor name and signature: ______________________  
   5.3 Quality inspector name and signature: ______________________
title: Product changeover - Hot Forge line

text:
# SOP-P1-L1-03 First-article inspection - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, EQ-P1-L1-IH03  
Related: MM-P1-L1-RR01, SOP-P1-L1-01, SOP-P1-L1-05

1. Preconditions
   1. Verify equipment listed is the intended equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, EQ-P1-L1-IH03.
   2. Ensure maintenance clearance and lockout are complete per MM-P1-L1-RR01 and SOP-P1-L1-01.
   3. Confirm first-article sample identity against production order and customer drawing.

2. PPE
   1. Wear required PPE as specified in plant procedures: hearing protection, eye protection, heat-resistant gloves, and protective aprons.
   2. Ensure PPE integrity prior to starting inspection.

3. Setup checks
   1. Confirm ring feed and holding fixtures are installed on EQ-P1-L1-RR01 per MM-P1-L1-RR01.
   2. Confirm toolholding and chuck condition on EQ-P1-L1-CN02.
   3. Check induction heater alignment on EQ-P1-L1-IH03.

4. Critical limits
   1. The chuck jaw bolt torque for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) is 100 N·m.
   2. The maximum ring outer diameter for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) is 1240 mm.

5. Inspection procedure
   1. Present first-article to inspection station and record part identifier.
   2. Measure dimensions called out on the drawing; document results on the first-article report.
   3. Perform visual inspection for forging defects, surface condition, and alignment.
   4. If any nonconformance is found, stop production and notify Quality and Production leads per SOP-P1-L1-05.

6. Documentation
   1. Complete first-article report fields, attach measurement data and photographic evidence.
   2. File report in the document control system and link to production order.

7. Sign-off
   1. Inspector printed name, signature, and date.
   2. Production lead printed name, signature, and date.
   3. Quality engineer printed name, signature, and date.
title: First-article inspection - Hot Forge line

text:
# SOP-P1-L1-04 - Shift handover - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, EQ-P1-L1-IH03

Purpose
1. Provide consistent, auditable shift-to-shift handover for the Hot Forge line.

Preconditions
2. Incoming and outgoing operators must have completed required training and are authorized for P1-L1 operations per SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-02.
3. Equipment status confirmed available in CMMS and maintenance references reviewed in MM-P1-L1-IH03.

PPE
4. Required PPE for handover and brief inspection:
   4.1. Use hearing protection, heat-resistant gloves, eye protection, and steel-toe footwear.
   4.2. Follow additional PPE requirements posted at each station.

Shift Handover Steps
5. Step 1 — Initial overview
   5.1. Outgoing operator summarizes current production batch, shift yield, and any deviation noted during the shift.
   5.2. Note any in-process parts or billets staged at EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, or EQ-P1-L1-IH03.

6. Step 2 — Equipment condition and consumables
   6.1. Confirm visual condition of EQ-P1-L1-IH03 and record any anomalies.
   6.2. Verify lubricant part numbers for referenced equipment:
       - The lubricant part number for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is CFW-LUB-188.
       - The lubricant part number for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) is CFW-LUB-508.
   6.3. Report any low or depleted consumables to maintenance per MM-P1-L1-IH03.

7. Step 3 — Safety and quality issues
   7.1. Review any safety incidents, near misses, or quality rejects.
   7.2. Ensure any containment or hold tags are identified and location communicated.

8. Step 4 — Actions and follow-up
   8.1. List outstanding actions, responsible person, and required reference document: SOP-P1-L1-01, SOP-P1-L1-02, MM-P1-L1-IH03.

Sign-off
9. Both outgoing and incoming operators must sign and time the handover record. Include operator names, start/end of handover, and any immediate actions agreed.

Change history
10. Rev A — Initial release.
title: Shift handover - Hot Forge line

text:
# SOP-P1-L1-05 Planned shutdown - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, EQ-P1-L1-IH03  
Related: ECN-2026-003, MM-P1-L1-IH03, SOP-P1-L1-02

1. Scope
   1.1 This procedure defines the planned shutdown sequence for the Hot Forge line equipment listed above.

2. Preconditions
   2.1 Verify production hold is authorized per SOP-P1-L1-02.  
   2.2 Review recent change notices and maintenance history: ECN-2026-003 and MM-P1-L1-IH03.  
   2.3 Ensure operators assigned are trained on EQ-P1-L1-RR01, EQ-P1-L1-CN02, EQ-P1-L1-IH03.

3. Shutdown sequence
   3.1 Isolate automation control and place systems in manual mode per MM-P1-L1-IH03.  
   3.2 Secure material feed to EQ-P1-L1-RR01 and confirm no parts in transfer path.  
   3.3 For EQ-P1-L1-CN02 perform spindle cool/lock procedures and complete electrical isolation. The spindle warm-up time for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) is 21 minutes.  
   3.4 For EQ-P1-L1-IH03 reduce heater output per ECN-2026-003, confirm coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 72 L/min, then secure power isolation per lockout/tagout.  
   3.5 Verify EQ-P1-L1-RR01 mechanical stops engaged and pneumatic supply isolated.

4. Post-shutdown checks
   4.1 Verify that all control panels are in the OFF or SAFE state.  
   4.2 Log isolation tags and confirm removal criteria per MM-P1-L1-IH03.

5. Personal protective equipment (PPE)
   5.1 Required PPE: safety glasses, cut-resistant gloves, steel-toe footwear, hearing protection, and arc-rated outerwear where applicable. Use lockout/tagout PPE per MM-P1-L1-IH03.

6. Sign-off
   6.1 Operator completing shutdown prints name, signs, and records time.  
   6.2 Maintenance and production supervisors review and sign.  
   6.3 Attach completed shutdown checklist to the work order and reference SOP-P1-L1-02 for restart criteria.
title: Planned shutdown - Hot Forge line

text:
# SOP-P1-L2-01 Line startup - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01, EQ-P1-L2-IH02, EQ-P1-L2-HT03

1. Preconditions
   1.1. Verify plant utilities available and stable per ECN-2026-009.  
   1.2. Confirm preventive maintenance completed on EQ-P1-L2-RR01, EQ-P1-L2-IH02, EQ-P1-L2-HT03 per SB-1008.  
   1.3. Ensure material traceability documents present and match work order per SB-1020.

2. Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
   2.1. Mandatory: safety glasses, heat-resistant gloves, steel-toe footwear, hearing protection, and face shield during furnace and induction operations.  
   2.2. Use insulated handling tools for hot billet transfer.  
   2.3. Restrict non-essential personnel from the immediate equipment area until sign-off.

3. Startup sequence
   3.1. Power-up and controller self-checks for EQ-P1-L2-RR01. Confirm no active faults before enabling roll drive.  
   3.2. Energize EQ-P1-L2-IH02 and confirm billet positioning sensors report ready. Confirm lubricant part number for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is CFW-LUB-788.  
   3.3. Bring EQ-P1-L2-HT03 to operational mode and confirm safety interlocks. The quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 24 seconds. Monitor quench sequence to ensure delay does not exceed this value.  
   3.4. Feed first billet to EQ-P1-L2-RR01 at technician direction; observe roll engagement and material tracking for one complete revolution cycle. Abort on abnormal noise or motion.

4. Fault response
   4.1. If any interlock trips, stop feed, isolate equipment, and notify maintenance per ECN-2026-009.  
   4.2. Record fault codes and actions taken on the electronic log.

5. Sign-off
   5.1. Operator: print name, badge ID, signature, time.  
   5.2. Shift Lead: verify startup parameters, confirm PPE compliance, sign and date.  
   5.3. Maintenance: confirm no outstanding open work orders affecting safety, sign.

References: ECN-2026-009, SB-1008, SB-1020
title: Line startup - Ring Rolling line

# SOP-P1-L2-02 Product changeover - Ring Rolling line
Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01, EQ-P1-L2-IH02, EQ-P1-L2-HT03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-041, MM-P1-L2-RR01, SOP-P1-L2-03

1. Purpose
   1.1 Perform product changeover on Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) and associated upstream/downstream equipment with minimal downtime and no damage to tooling or parts.

2. Preconditions
   2.1 Verify ECN-2026-041 has been released for the target part.  
   2.2 Confirm tooling and fixtures called out in MM-P1-L2-RR01 are available and inspected.  
   2.3 Ensure production schedule allows planned changeover and SOP-P1-L2-03 approvals are complete.

3. Required equipment setting limits
   3.1 The maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 995 mm. Do not attempt to roll rings with outer diameter greater than 995 mm.

4. Lubricant and consumables
   4.1 Use lubricant part CFW-LUB-788 for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02). Confirm lot traceability before use.

5. Changeover procedure (sequence)
   5.1 Stop production per equipment shutdown checklist. Verify all moving parts at rest.  
   5.2 Lockout/tagout per plant LOTO policy and confirm isolation.  
   5.3 Remove current ring set and record serials per MM-P1-L2-RR01. Store tooling in designated rack.  
   5.4 Install new ring set and fixtures. Align per MM-P1-L2-RR01. Check clearances and seating.  
   5.5 Apply CFW-LUB-788 to contact surfaces identified in MM-P1-L2-RR01.  
   5.6 Restore power and perform dry run without feedstock to verify mechanical motion and safety interlocks.  
   5.7 Introduce trial billet and validate final diameter does not exceed 995 mm. Inspect first-piece quality per MM-P1-L2-RR01.  
   5.8 If first-piece passes, transition to production mode and monitor initial pieces for conformance.

6. PPE
   6.1 Mandatory: safety glasses, cut-resistant gloves, steel-toe boots, hearing protection, and arc-rated clothing as required by plant policy.

7. Nonconformance
   7.1 If equipment or part nonconformance is found, stop and notify maintenance per ECN-2026-041.

8. Sign-off
   8.1 Operator: ______________________ Date: __________  
   8.2 Shift Lead: _____________________ Date: __________  
   8.3 Maintenance: ____________________ Date: __________

Document controlled per SOP-P1-L2-03 and MM-P1-L2-RR01.
title: Product changeover - Ring Rolling line

text:
# SOP-P1-L2-03 First-article inspection - Ring Rolling line
Revision: Rev D
Plant: P1, line P1-L2
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01, EQ-P1-L2-IH02, EQ-P1-L2-HT03

Preconditions
1. Work order for first-article inspection released and material certified.
2. Machine safety guards installed and functional on EQ-P1-L2-RR01 and EQ-P1-L2-IH02.
3. The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is CFW-LUB-961. Verify lubricant availability and reservoir fill level.
4. The target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 1230 °C. Confirm induction heater setpoint matches target.

Required PPE
1. Heat-resistant gloves rated for forged part handling.
2. Face shield with side protection.
3. Safety glasses.
4. Hearing protection.
5. Steel-toe footwear and flame-resistant clothing.

Procedure (numbered steps)
1. Confirm preconditions and PPE compliance. Record deviations and obtain authorization before proceeding.
2. Inspect EQ-P1-L2-IH02 controls. Verify setpoint equals the target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 1230 °C and log the reading to the inspection record.
3. Verify billet dimensions and material certification match the work order before loading into EQ-P1-L2-IH02.
4. Load billet into EQ-P1-L2-IH02 and execute heat cycle. Monitor temperature to ensure maintenance of the setpoint specified in step 2.
5. Transfer heated billet to EQ-P1-L2-RR01 using designated handling tool. Maintain PPE and observe safe clearances.
6. Prior to rolling, confirm lubrication on EQ-P1-L2-RR01 corresponds to CFW-LUB-961 and that distribution mechanism is functioning.
7. Perform ring rolling passes as required for first-article geometry. Inspect ring geometry at in-process checkpoints and document measurements on the first-article inspection form.
8. If out-of-tolerance conditions are observed, stop the line, tag parts, and initiate corrective action per MM-P1-L2-RR01 and MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1.
9. Perform final dimensional and surface inspection on cooled ring per MM-P1-L2-IH02 and record results.

Non-conformance and documentation
1. Record all measurements and deviations on the first-article inspection form.
2. Reference MM-P1-L2-IH02, MM-P1-L2-RR01, MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1 for maintenance and corrective procedures.

Sign-off
Operator: ______________________
Inspector: ______________________
Date: ______________________
title: First-article inspection - Ring Rolling line

text:
# SOP-P1-L2-05 Planned shutdown - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01, EQ-P1-L2-IH02, EQ-P1-L2-HT03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-041, QS-PROC-03, SOP-P1-L2-04

Preconditions
1. Confirm production schedule permits planned shutdown.  
2. Verify that maintenance authorization is present and referenced in ECN-2026-041.  
3. Ensure spare parts and tools listed in SOP-P1-L2-04 are staged at the work area.

PPE
1. Wear required PPE per QS-PROC-03.  
2. Additional required PPE for hot work and handling components: heat-resistant gloves and face shield compliant with plant PPE policy.

Procedure
1. Notify Operations and Maintenance control of planned shutdown and obtain clearance to isolate EQ-P1-L2-RR01, EQ-P1-L2-IH02, and EQ-P1-L2-HT03.  
2. Isolate electrical supply to the specified equipment and verify lockout/tagout per QS-PROC-03.  
3. Drain hydraulic and lubricating circuits and capture fluids for disposal per facility environmental procedure referenced in ECN-2026-041.  
4. De-energize induction systems and allow cooling until safe to handle components. The target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 1230 °C. Technicians must confirm temperature reading against that target prior to billet removal.  
5. Inspect and secure radial ring rolling mill components on EQ-P1-L2-RR01. Replace lubricant with the lubricant part number for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is CFW-LUB-961 and document usage.  
6. Perform mechanical inspections, cleanings, and any part exchanges specified in SOP-P1-L2-04 and record findings. Refer to ECN-2026-041 for any engineering changes required.  
7. Reassemble per OEM and plant specifications, verify alignments, and restore fluid levels as documented in SOP-P1-L2-04.

Sign-off
1. Maintenance lead completes and signs this SOP form confirming all steps and references to QS-PROC-03 and ECN-2026-041 were followed.  
2. Operations lead verifies equipment readiness and signs release to service.
title: Planned shutdown - Ring Rolling line

text:
# SOP-P1-L3-01 Line startup - Machining line

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, EQ-P1-L3-CN03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-029, SB-1026, SOP-P1-L3-02

1. Preconditions
   1.1 Verify area is clear of loose materials and unauthorized personnel.  
   1.2 Confirm completion of preventive checks per SOP-P1-L3-02.  
   1.3 Confirm calibration status of process sensors per ECN-2026-029 and SB-1026.

2. PPE
   2.1 Required: safety glasses, hearing protection, heat-resistant gloves, steel-toe footwear, and face shield.  
   2.2 Inspect PPE for damage before use and replace as necessary.

3. Initialization
   3.1 Verify power to EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, and EQ-P1-L3-CN03 is available and isolation procedures are complete.  
   3.2 Confirm hydraulic fluid reservoir level and that the lubricant part number for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is CFW-LUB-497.  
   3.3 Start induction billet heater EQ-P1-L3-IH01 and confirm control display reads the target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C before feeding billets.

4. Machine bring-up
   4.1 Start EQ-P1-L3-CN03 conveyor at low speed and confirm alignment.  
   4.2 Energize EQ-P1-L3-HP02 press control and run a dry cycle without billet to verify motion and interlocks.  
   4.3 Observe for abnormal noise, vibration, leaks, or alarms during initial cycles.

5. Verification and handoff
   5.1 Verify process control parameters stabilize and all interlocks remain set.  
   5.2 Document startup readings and any deviations. Refer to ECN-2026-029 for reporting form.

6. PPE removal and area secure
   6.1 Remove PPE in designated area and follow contamination control per SB-1026.

7. Sign-off
   7.1 Operator: print name and sign.  
   7.2 Supervisor: review startup records and sign when satisfied that the line is ready for production.
title: Line startup - Machining line

text:
# SOP-P1-L3-02 Product changeover - Machining line

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, EQ-P1-L3-CN03

Related documents: ECN-2026-043, MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1, SB-1026

1. Scope
   1.1 This procedure defines the required steps to perform a product changeover on the machining line using EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, and EQ-P1-L3-CN03.

2. Preconditions
   2.1 Ensure ECN-2026-043 has been reviewed for the target configuration.  
   2.2 Verify MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1 is available for CN03 setup reference.  
   2.3 Machine state must be stable, with no active alarms. Refer to SB-1026 for lockout guidance.

3. PPE
   3.1 Mandatory: safety glasses, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, steel-toe footwear.  
   3.2 Use heat-rated gloves when handling billets from EQ-P1-L3-IH01.

4. Changeover steps
   4.1 Remove previous workholding and inspect spindle and chuck per MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1.  
   4.2 Install new jaws and verify seating. The chuck jaw bolt torque for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) is 95 N·m. Torque to specification and log in the changeover record.  
   4.3 Load billet into EQ-P1-L3-IH01. The target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C. Confirm heater reaches and stabilizes at the target before transfer.  
   4.4 Transfer billet to EQ-P1-L3-HP02 per handling procedure and place in pickup station for EQ-P1-L3-CN03.  
   4.5 Run dry cycle for verification without cutting fluid; confirm workholding alignment and program zero. Refer to MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1 for program offsets.  
   4.6 Start monitored trial piece production and inspect first-piece dimensions. If nonconforming, stop and escalate per ECN-2026-043.

5. Documentation

# SOP-P1-L3-05 Planned shutdown - Machining line

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, EQ-P1-L3-CN03

1. Preconditions
   1. Ensure production hold is recorded in MES and line is scheduled for planned shutdown.
   2. Confirm maintenance permits are active and communicated to operations and safety.
   3. Verify that the target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C and that heater control is set to safe cooldown mode.
   4. Isolate energy sources to EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, and EQ-P1-L3-CN03 per lockout/tagout.

2. Personal protective equipment (PPE)
   1. Wear safety glasses, face shield, hearing protection, heat-resistant gloves, and steel-toe footwear.
   2. Use insulated gloves when working on hot systems or when verifying the induction heater and when handling tooling from the press.

3. Shutdown procedure
   1. Stop feed and hold workpieces clear of machining and forging areas.
   2. Execute controlled cooldown for furnace and induction heater until verified at target billet temperature of 1235 °C or below for safe handling.
   3. Depressurize hydraulic circuits and bleed hydraulic accumulators on EQ-P1-L3-HP02.
   4. When access to the press is granted, verify main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is set to 1330 N·m as part of pre-service checks.
   5. Secure tooling and remove chips and debris from cell using approved methods.

4. Verification and returning to service
   1. Complete post-shutdown inspection checklist and corrective actions.
   2. Test machine functions under maintenance control prior to re-energizing.
   3. Restore energy sources only after all personnel and tools are clear.

5. Sign-off
   1. Maintenance lead, shift supervisor, and safety officer shall sign to confirm completion of shutdown, verification of the specified temperatures and torque, and release for restart.

Related documents: ECN-2026-021, ECN-2026-029, ECN-2026-043

Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-CN01, EQ-P1-L4-HP02, EQ-P1-L4-HT03

Purpose
1. Restore Heat Treat line to production-ready status following cold shutdown or maintenance, ensuring equipment EQ-P1-L4-CN01, EQ-P1-L4-HP02, and EQ-P1-L4-HT03 are verified.

Preconditions
1. All maintenance work on listed equipment completed and documented.  
2. Lockout/tagout removed by originator and verified.  
3. Utilities available and stable.

Required PPE
1. Safety glasses.  
2. Heat-resistant gloves.  
3. Hearing protection.  
4. Arc-rated face shield as required by task.

Startup Procedure
1. Visual inspection: verify guards, safety interlocks, and emergency stops are operational.  
2. Power enable: confirm source feeds and enable main disconnect at the line control panel for EQ-P1-L4-HP02 and EQ-P1-L4-HT03.  
3. CNC warm-up: Execute spindle warm-up cycle on EQ-P1-L4-CN01. The spindle warm-up time for Heat Treat CNC turning center #1 (EQ-P1-L4-CN01) is 15 minutes. Do not proceed until cycle completes and diagnostics show no faults.  
4. Heat treat furnace initiation: Initiate furnace control sequence on EQ-P1-L4-HT03 and monitor controller for alarm state. Observe control feedback until stable. The quench delay maximum for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is 15 seconds. Verify controller quench delay parameter is within this limit.  
5. Functional test: Run single-piece trial through full heat treat path with operator at guarded control station. Confirm part flow, quench timing, and cool-down staging per SB-1046 and SOP-P1-L4-04.  
6. Transition to production: After successful trial and QA sign-off, enable normal cycle and notify production scheduling per SOP-P1-L4-03.

Deviations
1. If any alarm or unexpected behavior occurs, stop and follow lockout/tagout and escalate to maintenance.

   - Drain and isolate hydraulic service lines to EQ-P1-L4-HP02. The system pressure limit for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is 300 bar. Confirm isolation prior to maintenance.

5. Mechanical disassembly and inspection  
   - Remove guards and shields following MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2. Inspect hydraulic fittings, seals, and quench delivery lines. Replace components per parts list in ECN-2026-007.

6. Test and verification prior to restart  
   - Reassemble guards, reapply utilities, and perform functional checks in accordance with MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 and MM-P1-L4-HT03-S3. Verify quench timing and hydraulic pressure alarms.

   2.1 Mandatory: hearing protection, flame-resistant coveralls, safety glasses, steel-toe footwear.

   3.1 Conduct visual inspection of EQ-P2-L1-SB03 and ensure access panels are secured.

   3.3 Energize peripheral systems and confirm interlocks on EQ-P2-L1-IH02 are satisfied.

   3.5 On EQ-P2-L1-RR01, verify mandrel clamp condition and confirm: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 430 N·m. If torque does not match recorded torque, secure with approved tools and retest before loading material.  
   3.6 Load first piece and run single-piece heat/roll sequence under supervision. Monitor alarms and emergency stops.

4. Abnormal conditions
   4.1 Any interlock, alarm, or abnormal vibration requires immediate stop and notification of maintenance per SB-1001.

   4.6 Run one trial billet, inspect part dimensions and surface; reference SOP-P2-L1-05 for acceptance criteria.  
   4.7 If trial fails, stop, document deviation, and notify engineering per ECN-2026-023.

5. Tag and lockout all feed and control panels following SB-1030 tagging procedures.

7. Remove guarding only after panels are isolated; perform required inspections and repairs.
8. Re-energize only after completion of work, clearance from safety lead, and checklist verification per QS-PROC-06 and ECN-2026-033.

Post-shutdown Verification

# SOP-P2-L2-02 Product changeover - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-IH01, EQ-P2-L2-HT02, EQ-P2-L2-RR03

Preconditions
1. Verify line is in locked-out state and control power is isolated per MM-P2-L2-RR03.
2. Confirm all work permits and clearances are issued and visible at worksite per SB-1017.

PPE
1. Safety glasses with side shields.
2. Cut-resistant gloves for handling billets and tooling.
3. Steel-toe footwear and hearing protection.

Procedure (numbered steps)
1. Remove current mandrel assembly from EQ-P2-L2-RR03 following mechanical isolation. Tag out per MM-P2-L2-RR03.
2. Inspect mandrel interface and clamp points visually; clean mating faces with approved solvent from approved kit.
3. Install new mandrel assembly aligned to datum on EQ-P2-L2-RR03. Hand-fit bolts and confirm full seating.
4. Tighten mandrel clamp bolts to the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 620 N·m using calibrated torque wrench. Record torque values on changeover form.
5. Verify induction heater billet support in EQ-P2-L2-IH01 is adjusted for billet size and clearance per SB-1049.
6. Confirm coil cooling water flow for induction billet heater is active and meets process requirement: The coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 81 L/min. Verify flow on panel readout; if below minimum, stop changeover and notify maintenance per MM-P2-L2-RR03.
7. Install ring stock and center under headstock on EQ-P2-L2-RR03. Confirm visual alignment and clearances.
8. Remove lockout/tagout following verification steps in MM-P2-L2-RR03. Execute dry-run at feed and rotate speeds established in line recipe stored in control system.
9. Monitor first three parts for dimensional and surface acceptance. Record observations and attach sample parts if any nonconformance.

Sign-off
1. Operator name and signature.
2. Shift supervisor name and signature.
3. Maintenance verifier name and signature.

text:
# SOP-P2-L2-05 Planned shutdown - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-IH01, EQ-P2-L2-HT02, EQ-P2-L2-RR03

Purpose
1. Provide controlled sequence for planned shutdown of the Ring Rolling line including isolation, safe energy control, and cooldown handover to maintenance.

Preconditions
2. Production stop completed and no live billets in feed conveyors.  
3. Maintenance work order and access permit issued referencing ECN-2026-012 and ECN-2026-050.  
4. Confirm MM-P2-L2-HT02 has acknowledged heat treat furnace status.

Required PPE
5. Personnel must wear PPE per plant standard: hard hat, safety glasses, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, and flame-resistant jacket.

Shutdown sequence
6. Isolate main power to EQ-P2-L2-IH01 and EQ-P2-L2-RR03 at the designated lockout points. Apply individual locks and tags.  
7. Place EQ-P2-L2-HT02 in Hold mode using control panel interlock. Verify control panel indicates Hold before proceeding.  
8. Drain and secure hydraulic accumulators on EQ-P2-L2-RR03 following manufacturer procedure.  
9. Verify all motion has stopped and confirm zero-energy state with multi-party verification. Record verifier names on the permit.  
10. Remove lubricants only when components are cool to touch. For EQ-P2-L2-HT02 replacement or service use lubricant part number for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is CFW-LUB-376.  
11. Do not perform furnace hearth entry until thermal confirmation is obtained. The austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is 855 °C. Confirm control readback is below acceptable threshold per MM-P2-L2-HT02 before entry.

Isolation verification
12. Perform verification checklist and sign each item. Include verification of mechanical blocks and tagout status.

Handover to Maintenance
13. Complete handover form, attach permit, and route to maintenance lead. Cite ECN-2026-012 and ECN-2026-050 in the handover.

Sign-off
14. Operations lead sign-off: name, signature, and date.  
15. Maintenance lead sign-off: name, signature, and date.  
16. Safety officer sign-off: name, signature, and date.
title: Planned shutdown - Ring Rolling line

Troubleshooting and Escalation
13. If coolant flow cannot reach required value, isolate system and notify Maintenance per MM-P2-L3-IH03-S3.

text:
# SOP-P2-L3-05 Planned shutdown - Machining line

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-RR01, EQ-P2-L3-HT02, EQ-P2-L3-IH03  
Related: ECN-2026-037, MM-P2-L3-IH03-S3, QS-PROC-10

1. Preconditions
   1. Verify production schedule cleared for planned shutdown of line P2-L3.
   2. Confirm maintenance work order released per ECN-2026-037.
   3. Ensure EH&S hold points identified in QS-PROC-10 are addressed.
   4. For EQ-P2-L3-IH03 confirm coil cooling water flow meets specification: The coil cooling water flow minimum for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03) is 72 L/min.
   5. For EQ-P2-L3-HT02 confirm setpoints for heat treatment: The austenitizing setpoint for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02) is 845 °C.

2. Sequence of operations
   1. Inform control room and affected operators that P2-L3 will enter planned shutdown.
   2. Place EQ-P2-L3-RR01 into safe stop per lockout procedure in MM-P2-L3-IH03-S3.
   3. Isolate feed and hydraulic supplies to EQ-P2-L3-RR01 and tag per QS-PROC-10.
   4. De-energize EQ-P2-L3-IH03 and verify coil cooling flow at or above 72 L/min before dewatering or coil access.
   5. Place EQ-P2-L3-HT02 in maintenance mode and confirm austenitizing setpoint 845 °C recorded and secured prior to any furnace access.
   6. Perform required maintenance and inspections per MM-P2-L3-IH03-S3 and ECN-2026-037.

3. PPE
   1. Required PPE: safety glasses, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, and arc-rated clothing where arc flash hazard is present as noted in QS-PROC-10.
   2. Additional PPE directed by maintenance supervisor based on task hazard assessment.

4. Post-maintenance checks
   1. Restore mechanical guards and conduct functional test procedures per MM-P2-L3-IH03-S3.
   2. Verify coil cooling system returns to operational flow and that EQ-P2-L3-HT02 setpoints are restored to production values.

5. Sign-off
   1. Maintenance lead prints name and signs.
   2. Line supervisor prints name and signs.
   3. Plant safety officer prints name and signs.

Plant: P2, line P2-L4

Preconditions:

2. EQ-P2-L4-RR01 roll-runner line cleared of previous product and tagged per MM-P2-L4-RR01.

PPE:
4. Required PPE: safety glasses, heat-resistant gloves, face shield, steel-toe boots. Use hearing protection when alarms are active.

Changeover steps:
5. Verify current product program and confirm changeover authorization in the control system for EQ-P2-L4-HT02 and EQ-P2-L4-HP03.
6. Confirm the austenitizing setpoint for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L4-HT02) is 885 °C. Do not proceed if setpoint differs.
7. Purge furnace atmosphere per plant atmosphere purge procedure referenced in ECN-2026-045; confirm oxygen sensor is within allowable limits before charging.
8. Load billets from EQ-P2-L4-RR01 using standard transfer protocol in MM-P2-L4-RR01. Verify part geometry against changeover checklist.
9. Before first press stroke, confirm the system pressure limit for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) is 320 bar. Lock out any command that would exceed this limit.
10. Run one verification cycle: heat to setpoint, transfer, press cycle, quench/recovery per SOP-P2-L4-03 procedures. Inspect first three parts for dimensional and metallurgical acceptance criteria.
11. If verification fails, stop line, tag product, notify maintenance and engineering, and reference ECN-2026-045 for disposition.

Sign-off:
12. Complete changeover log with operator name, start and end times, and checklist items referenced. Initial and date the log.
13. Supervisor verifies first-batch acceptance and signs the changeover record. Retain records per ECN-2026-045.

Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-HP01, EQ-P3-L1-SB02, EQ-P3-L1-IH03

Preconditions
1. All preventive maintenance tasks completed per SB-1044 and SOP-P3-L1-02.

PPE
1. Safety glasses with side shields.  
2. Heat-resistant gloves and apron.  
3. Steel-toe footwear and hearing protection.  
4. Face shield for shot-blast inspection tasks.

Startup Steps
1. Visual inspection: walk the line and verify guards, safety interlocks, and emergency stops are present and unobstructed.  
2. Verify lubricant reservoir and labeling for EQ-P3-L1-SB02; confirm The lubricant part number for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02) is CFW-LUB-278. Top-up only with approved product.  
3. Check shot-blast media containment and access doors; confirm liners secured. For EQ-P3-L1-SB02, verify blast wheel liner bolts are torqued to specification: The blast wheel liner bolt torque for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02) is 65 N·m.  
4. Power-up sequence: energize pumps and blowers, monitor for abnormal noise or vibration; report discrepancies to maintenance per SOP-P3-L1-04.  
5. Warm-up and control check: validate control interlocks, confirm readbacks and alarms are functional. Do not proceed if an interlock fails.  
6. Trial cycle: run a single-cycle empty pass through EQ-P3-L1-HP01 and EQ-P3-L1-IH03 to confirm handling and indexing. Observe for material transfer issues.  
7. Validate scrap and reject routing; ensure caught parts are routed to designated containment and logged.

Non-conformance
1. If any step fails, stop and tag the line; notify the shift lead and initiate corrective action per SB-1044.

Sign-off

text:
# SOP-P3-L1-02 Product changeover - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-HP01, EQ-P3-L1-SB02, EQ-P3-L1-IH03  
Related: ECN-2026-006, MM-P3-L1-IH03, SB-1027

1. Purpose
   1.1. Define safe steps to change over Hot Forge line tools and process settings between part families.

2. Preconditions
   2.1. All operators must have completed line-specific training and hold current permits per ECN-2026-006.  
   2.2. Confirm production schedule authorisation and tool availability.  
   2.3. Verify maintenance clearances on EQ-P3-L1-HP01, EQ-P3-L1-SB02, EQ-P3-L1-IH03.

3. PPE
   3.1. Wear heat-resistant gloves, face shield, hearing protection and safety shoes.  
   3.2. Use insulated sleeves when interacting with EQ-P3-L1-IH03 components. Refer to MM-P3-L1-IH03 for heater-specific PPE notes.

4. Changeover steps
   4.1. Stop feed and lockout/tagout following SB-1027 procedures.  
   4.2. Drain and secure hydraulic lines on EQ-P3-L1-HP01 per manufacturer guidance. Replace lubricant with CFW-LUB-927 and document the change in maintenance log.  
   4.3. Remove and install dies on EQ-P3-L1-HP01 using lift-assist tools; inspect die interfaces for wear.  
   4.4. Adjust scrap conveyor and shot-blast settings on EQ-P3-L1-SB02 to match new die geometry.  
   4.5. On EQ-P3-L1-IH03, confirm induction heater setpoint and measure billet condition. The target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03) is 1260 °C. Record measured value against target and tag any deviation for corrective action per ECN-2026-006.  
   4.6. Perform cold trial sequence without billet heating to verify mechanical alignment, then perform heated trial with operator supervision. Record all observations in the lot changeover sheet.

5. Acceptance criteria
   5.1. Dies secure, lubricant CFW-LUB-927 installed, conveyors adjusted, and measured billet reaches the target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03) is 1260 °C in trial run.  
   5.2. No safety holds or tool interlocks active; quality samples within acceptance.

6. Sign-off
   6.1. Changeover completed by: ____________________  
   6.2. Line supervisor: ____________________  
   6.3. Maintenance representative (if CFW-LUB-927 fitted): ____________________  

References: ECN-2026-006; MM-P3-L1-IH03; SB-1027
title: Product changeover - Hot Forge line

# SOP-P3-L1-04 Shift handover - Hot Forge line
Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-HP01, EQ-P3-L1-SB02, EQ-P3-L1-IH03

1. Preconditions
   1.1. Outgoing operator confirms line in stable state and communicates active work orders.  
   1.2. Verify that coil cooling water flow meets required cooling for EQ-P3-L1-IH03: The coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03) is 65 L/min.  
   1.3. Verify that visible hardware fasteners on hydraulic forging press are intact: The main ram bolt torque for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01) is 1425 N·m.  
   1.4. Check status of scrap bin and conveyor on EQ-P3-L1-SB02; report blockages to maintenance per MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1.

2. Handover procedure
   2.1. Outgoing operator briefs incoming operator on:
       - Current job, material heat numbers, special handling notes.
       - Any active alarms, faults, or interlocks on EQ-P3-L1-IH03 and EQ-P3-L1-HP01.
       - Recent maintenance actions referenced in MM-P3-L1-IH03 and MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1.
   2.2. Demonstrate control panel indicators and emergency stop locations for EQ-P3-L1-HP01 and EQ-P3-L1-IH03.
   2.3. Incoming operator performs independent walkdown, confirms preconditions in section 1, and signs the log.

3. Communication and escalation
   3.1. If coil cooling water flow is below the stated minimum, take the line to safe stop and notify maintenance per MM-P3-L1-IH03.
   3.2. If the main ram bolt torque is unknown or suspected incorrect, secure line and escalate to maintenance per MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1 and hold production per SOP-P3-L1-02.

4. PPE
   4.1. Required PPE for both outgoing and incoming operator: hearing protection, face shield, heat-resistant gloves, welding apron, safety boots, and high-visibility clothing.

text:
# SOP-P3-L1-05 Planned shutdown - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-HP01, EQ-P3-L1-SB02, EQ-P3-L1-IH03

Purpose
Provide stepwise, controlled procedure for planned shutdown of the Hot Forge line for maintenance and inspection.

Related documents
MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1, SB-1033, SB-1044

Preconditions
1. Notify production control and maintenance lead per plant notification protocol.  
2. Verify crews are trained for planned shutdown tasks and have read MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1.  
3. Confirm area is clear of workpieces and tooling.

Required PPE
1. Flame-resistant coveralls.  
2. Safety glasses with side shields.  
3. Hearing protection rated for plant environment.  
4. Cut-resistant gloves for handling tooling.  
5. Safety footwear with metatarsal protection.

Shutdown procedure
1. Isolate hydraulic power to EQ-P3-L1-HP01 following lockout/tagout as described in SB-1033.  
2. Secure electrical isolation for EQ-P3-L1-SB02 and EQ-P3-L1-IH03 per SB-1044.  
3. Drain hydraulic accumulators to safe state per MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1. The system pressure limit for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01) is 330 bar. Verify pressure gauge reads within safe range before proceeding.  
4. Remove bolted access panels and support with appropriate hoisting. The main ram bolt torque for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01) is 1425 N·m. Record bolt condition and torque history in maintenance log.  
5. Perform required inspection, cleaning, and replacement tasks as defined in MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1. Use suitable lifting devices for heavy components.  
6. Reassemble in reverse order. Re-torque main ram bolt to specified value and confirm torque documentation. Refill and repressurize hydraulic system according to MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1 and verify no leaks.

Post-shutdown verification
1. Remove lockout/tagout devices only after authorized sign-off.  
2. Conduct functional test cycles at low energy per MM-P3-L1-HP01-S1.  
3. Return equipment to production only after maintenance lead confirms all checks complete.

Sign-off
Maintenance Lead: ____________________  
Production Lead: ____________________  
Safety Officer: ____________________
title: Planned shutdown - Hot Forge line

# SOP-P3-L2-01 Line startup - Ring Rolling line

Startup Procedure
1. Visual inspection: Walk the conveyance and shot blast areas on EQ-P3-L2-SB01 and EQ-P3-L2-RR02. Confirm no foreign objects or loose hardware are present.
2. Fastener verification: Check the blast wheel liner bolts on EQ-P3-L2-SB01. Confirm the blast wheel liner bolt torque for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is 100 N·m and that torque verification is recorded on the inspection form.

5. Control power: Enable control power to EQ-P3-L2-RR02 and EQ-P3-L2-HT03 at the operator panel. Monitor for any alarms.
6. Dry run: Execute a dry run with no load on EQ-P3-L2-RR02 using operator interface. Verify motion profiles and interlock responses.
7. First-piece verification: Introduce first piece per SOP-P3-L2-03. Inspect rolled ring for dimensional and surface acceptance.
8. Stabilization: Monitor process until parameters are steady and within expected ranges. Use MM-P3-L2-RR02 for reference checks.

Deviations

6. Start trial run with single billet. Inspect ring geometry and surface finish against MM-P3-L2-RR02 acceptance criteria. Repeat trial until criteria met.  
7. Place approved parts into quarantine for heat treatment. Process parts through EQ-P3-L2-HT03 following SOP-P3-L2-01. The quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 13 seconds.

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, EQ-P3-L2-HT03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-044, MM-P3-L2-SB01, SB-1015

1. Purpose and scope  
   1.1 Purpose: Execute a planned shutdown of the Ring Rolling line to perform inspection, lubrication, and maintenance on EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, and EQ-P3-L2-HT03.  
   1.2 Scope: Applies to technicians and maintenance personnel assigned to P3-L2.

2. Preconditions (must be verified before shutdown)  
   2.1 Obtain authorization per ECN-2026-044.  
   2.2 Confirm production hold scheduled by Line Control.  
   2.3 Verify availability of maintenance materials per MM-P3-L2-SB01.  
   2.4 Ensure shot blast cabinet isolation valve and lockout procedures are available per SB-1015.

3. PPE required  
   3.1 Safety glasses, steel-toe boots, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, and flame-resistant coveralls.  
   3.2 Respiratory protection when entering enclosures where particulate control is not confirmed.

4. Shutdown and isolation sequence (stepwise)  
   4.1 Stop feed and allow machines to come to rest.  
   4.2 Lock out and tag out main electrical supplies for EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, EQ-P3-L2-HT03.  
   4.3 Verify zero energy at all lockout points before entry.  
   4.4 Bleed and lock pneumatic and hydraulic lines where applicable.  
   4.5 Drain residual materials from relevant housings per MM-P3-L2-SB01.

5. Lubrication instructions (use exact part numbers)  
   5.1 The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is CFW-LUB-930.  
   5.2 The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is CFW-LUB-463.  
   5.3 Apply lubricants only after surfaces are cleaned and manufacturer guidelines in MM-P3-L2-SB01 are followed.

6. Inspection and corrective actions  
   6.1 Inspect bearings, belts, guards, and sensors; document findings.  
   6.2 Record required corrective actions and reference ECN-2026-044 for engineering changes.

7. Recommissioning and handover  
   7.1 Remove locks and tags only after verifying all tools and personnel are clear.  
   7.2 Perform controlled restart and functional check.  
   7.3 Log restart in line control system.

8. Sign-off (required)  
   Operator: ____________________  Date: __________  
   Maintenance lead: ____________________  Date: __________  
   Engineering approval (if required per ECN-2026-044): ____________________  Date: __________

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3

Related documents: ECN-2026-016, MM-P3-L3-CN02, MM-P3-L3-CN02-S1

1. Purpose
   - Provide required actions to start the machining line and verify safe readiness of EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, and EQ-P3-L3-HP03.

2. Preconditions
   - Line power available and locked in accordance with facility lockout procedures.
   - Maintenance tasks from ECN-2026-016 completed and signed off.
   - Preventive maintenance on EQ-P3-L3-CN02 verified per MM-P3-L3-CN02 and MM-P3-L3-CN02-S1.

3. PPE
   - Safety glasses, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, steel-toe footwear, and face shield as required for machining operations.

4. Lubrication check
   - Confirm lubricant installed on EQ-P3-L3-CN02 matches part specification: The lubricant part number for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02) is CFW-LUB-611.

5. Mechanical torque verification
   - Verify main ram bolt on EQ-P3-L3-HP03 has been torqued to the required value: The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m.

6. Machine power-up sequence
   - Release local lockouts and follow machine control startup prompts for EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, then EQ-P3-L3-HP03.
   - Observe emergency stop logic and verify audible/visual alarms function.

7. Functional checks
   - Perform axis homing and tool detection on EQ-P3-L3-CN02.
   - Run single-stroke test on EQ-P3-L3-HP03 with guard in place to confirm motion and interlocks.

8. Quality and safety verification
   - Confirm first-part dimensions and clamping integrity.
   - Verify guarding and light curtains are operational.

9. Abnormal conditions
   - If alarms persist or torque/lubricant discrepant, secure equipment and notify maintenance per ECN-2026-016.

10. Sign-off
   - Operator prints name, signs, and records time. Supervisor verifies steps and initials completion.

Purpose
1. Verify first-article parts produced on line P3-L3 meet drawing and process requirements prior to production release.

Preconditions
1. Machine setup complete and verified against program for the part.
2. Tooling and fixtures installed per MM-P3-L3-HP03 and MM-P3-L3-SB01.

text:
# SOP-P3-L3-05 Planned shutdown - Machining line
Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, EQ-P3-L3-HP03

1. Purpose  
1.1 This procedure defines the planned shutdown sequence for the Machining line to permit safe maintenance, inspection, and component replacement on EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, and EQ-P3-L3-HP03.

2. Preconditions  
2.1 Verify work order and maintenance authorization is issued.  
2.2 Notify Production, Maintenance, and Safety.  
2.3 Lockout/tagout and energy isolation points determined per SB-1005.  
2.4 Confirm hydraulic accumulators are de-pressurized and secure.

3. Shutdown steps (sequence)  
3.1 Stop feed and isolate material flow on EQ-P3-L3-CN02. Confirm no part movement.  
3.2 Secure EQ-P3-L3-SB01 and relieve servo pressure per SB-1022.  
3.3 For EQ-P3-L3-HP03, verify hydraulic supply isolation and drain lines to service reservoir. The system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 295 bar. Ensure pressure gauges read zero before work.  
3.4 Remove guards and access panels following manufacturer access points.  
3.5 When main ram maintenance is required, check fasteners. The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m. Torque only when reassembling per torque tool calibration procedure.  
3.6 Perform required inspection, repair, or replacement actions. Record findings in the maintenance log.  
3.7 Reinstall guards and restore mechanical and electrical connections. Verify all tools and loose items are removed.

4. Restart verification  
4.1 Remove lockout/tagout only after responsible engineers confirm readiness.  
4.2 Energize hydraulic supply gradually and monitor for leaks and alarms. Validate functional tests on EQ-P3-L3-SB01 and EQ-P3-L3-CN02 before returning to production.

5. PPE  
5.1 Safety glasses, hearing protection, gloves, and steel-toe footwear. Follow plant PPE policy and use additional protective equipment for hydraulic fluid handling.

6. References  
- SB-1005  
- SB-1022  
- SOP-P3-L3-03

7. Sign-off  
Performed by: ______________________  
Maintenance lead: ______________________  
Safety officer: ______________________

Purpose
1. Define steps to perform safe startup of the Heat Treat line.

Preconditions
1. Utilities and mainline compressed air are available and stable.
2. All preventive maintenance actions listed in MM-P3-L4-HT02 and MM-P3-L4-SB03 are completed and recorded.
3. ECN-2026-026 approvals for any recent changes are implemented.

Required PPE
1. Safety glasses.
2. Leather gloves rated for work on hot-process equipment.
3. Hearing protection.
4. Flame-resistant clothing.
5. Steel-toe footwear.

Startup Procedure
1. Visual inspection
   1.1 Confirm no loose tools or foreign material in work area around EQ-P3-L4-HT02 and EQ-P3-L4-SB03.
   1.2 Verify guards and access panels on EQ-P3-L4-RR01 are secured.
2. Fastener verification
   2.1 Verify mandrel clamp bolts on EQ-P3-L4-RR01 are torqued to the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 605 N·m.
   2.2 Verify blast wheel liner bolts on EQ-P3-L4-SB03 are torqued to the blast wheel liner bolt torque for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03) is 90 N·m.
3. Electrical and control brings-up
   3.1 Place control in local mode and verify indicators for EQ-P3-L4-HT02.
   3.2 Bring drive systems online following control prompts. Observe for abnormal vibration or alarms.
4. Dry cycle
   4.1 Run a no-load dry cycle of the shot blast and ring roll subsystems and confirm proper sequence of interlocks.
5. Process readiness
   5.1 Confirm material flow and handling systems deliver parts to EQ-P3-L4-HT02 without obstruction.
   5.2 Confirm purge and exhaust functions are operating according to station requirements.
6. Production start
   6.1 Start production with the first part under supervised observation. Stop on any abnormal condition.

Deviations

1. Purpose
   1.1 Define the required steps to perform a product changeover on the Heat Treat line while maintaining part integrity and traceability.

2. Preconditions
   2.1 Production order and new part print available and verified per MM-P3-L4-RR01-S3.  
   2.2 All affected equipment at a complete stop and isolated per lockout procedures in MM-P3-L4-SB03.  
   2.3 Materials staging confirmed against SB-1019.

3. PPE
   3.1 Operators: heat-resistant gloves, safety glasses, hearing protection, and protective footwear.  
   3.2 Maintenance: arc-rated face shield for open furnace access and insulated gloves for handling hot tooling.

4. Changeover sequence
   4.1 Verify current recipe loaded on EQ-P3-L4-HT02 matches incoming product requirements.  
   4.2 Remove and tag outgoing tooling on EQ-P3-L4-RR01 using the traceability label process in MM-P3-L4-RR01-S3.

   4.4 Confirm blast cabinet consumables and lubricant status before startup; the lubricant part number for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03) is CFW-LUB-526.  
   4.5 Energize systems and perform first-part verification. The quench delay maximum for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 20 seconds.  
   4.6 Record first-part measurements and attach inspection tag per SB-1019.

5. Acceptance
   5.1 If first-part inspection meets requirements, commence limited production run and monitor for stability.  
   5.2 If nonconforming, stop line and notify maintenance per MM-P3-L4-SB03.

   6.1 Operator completing changeover signs name, employee ID, and timestamp on electronic record.

   1.1 Confirm production hold has been authorized by Plant Control.  
   1.2 Verify maintenance scope and parts list are approved.  
   1.3 Check EQ-P3-L4-SB03 dust collector status; note that the dust collector pressure drop alarm for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03) is 1510 Pa.  
   1.4 Confirm lubricant for EQ-P3-L4-SB03 is on-site: lubricant part number for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03) is CFW-LUB-526.  
   1.5 Review related maintenance procedures in MM-P3-L4-HT02 and MM-P3-L4-HT02-S2 and the operational checklist in SOP-P3-L4-01.

2. Required PPE
   2.1 Safety glasses.  
   2.2 Hearing protection.  
   2.3 Cut-resistant gloves.  
   2.4 Flame-resistant coveralls.  
   2.5 Respiratory protection as specified for abrasive cleaning tasks.

3. Shutdown steps
   3.1 Notify line operators and place visible shutdown tag at EQ-P3-L4-RR01, EQ-P3-L4-HT02, and EQ-P3-L4-SB03.  
   3.2 Isolate energy sources per lockout/tagout and verify zero energy state before entry. Reference MM-P3-L4-HT02 for isolation points.  
   3.3 Drain residual media and secure containment for EQ-P3-L4-SB03 per MM-P3-L4-HT02-S2.  
   3.4 Remove inspection panels and perform visual inspection of blast cabinet and collector housing. Record pressure drop alarm noted in preconditions.  
   3.5 Replace or top up lubricant CFW-LUB-526 where indicated by maintenance checklist.  
   3.6 Perform required maintenance, cleaning, and parts replacement following MM-P3-L4-HT02 procedures.

4. Restart verification
   4.1 Remove locks/tags after completing checklist items and confirming area is clear.  
   4.2 Power-up equipment and observe for normal operation. Confirm dust collector alarm clears from the value noted in preconditions.

5. Sign-off
   5.1 Completed by: ______________________  Date: ______________________  
   5.2 Reviewed by Maintenance Lead: ______________________  Date: ______________________
title: Planned shutdown - Heat Treat line

# MM-P1-L1-RR01 Maintenance manual - Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev B
Plant: P1, line P1-L1
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01

Scope
This document defines preventive maintenance tasks for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) at P1, line P1-L1. It covers mandrel clamp bolt torque verification and main roll bearing lubrication timing, and refers to machine safety and lockout procedures in SB-1025 and operational steps in SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-05.

Tools
- Torque wrench calibrated to the range required for mandrel clamp bolt application.
- Clean rags and approved lubricants per machine specification.
- Low lint brushes and grease pump suitable for bearing fittings.
- Lockout/tagout devices per SB-1025.

Procedure
- Isolate energy sources and apply lockout per SB-1025 before maintenance work. Verify isolation visually and by attempting normal start controls.
- Access mandrel clamp bolts following access guidance in SOP-P1-L1-01. Clean bolt threads and seating surfaces to remove debris and old lubricant.
- Set torque wrench to the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01): 635 N·m. Apply torque evenly to each clamp bolt using a cross pattern to ensure uniform seating. Record applied torque in the equipment maintenance log.
- Inspect main rolls and access bearing grease fittings per SOP-P1-L1-05. Lubricate main roll bearings at the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01): 120 hours. Use lubricant specified in the asset lubrication chart. Purge old grease until clean lubricant appears at bearing seals, then add manufacturer recommended quantity.
- Complete post-maintenance checks: verify guards, reset interlocks, and restore power per SB-1025.

Acceptance criteria
- All mandrel clamp bolts remain at set torque with no visible looseness and no damage to bolt threads or clamp seating.
- Main roll bearings show clean lubricant flow with no contamination visible at seals and no abnormal noise during run-up.
- Maintenance actions logged and cross-referenced to SOP-P1-L1-01, SOP-P1-L1-05, and SB-1025.
title: Maintenance manual - Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1

text:
# MM-P1-L1-CN02 - Maintenance manual - Hot Forge CNC turning center #2

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-CN02

Scope
This document defines preventive maintenance steps required to verify mechanical integrity and operational readiness of Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02). Tasks cover chuck verification, spindle warm-up, and functional checks prior to production use.

Tools
- Torque wrench calibrated for torque application
- Standard hand tools as required for jaw removal and inspection
- Clean lint-free cloth and approved lubricants per SOP-P1-L1-04

Procedure
- Prepare machine per lockout/tagout and safety rules referenced in SOP-P1-L1-03.
- Inspect chuck jaws for wear, cracks, and debris. Clean mating surfaces with lint-free cloth.
- Apply torque to each chuck jaw bolt on EQ-P1-L1-CN02 using a torque wrench set to 100 N·m. Verify torque setting visually and by wrench reading.
- Re-install jaws and perform static seating verification by hand to confirm axial engagement.
- Start spindle warm-up cycle. Allow spindle runtime until spindle warm-up time for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) reaches 21 minutes before applying production loads.
- While spindle is warming, monitor for abnormal vibration, noise, or alarms. Record anomalies and tag machine out of service if any are detected.
- After warm-up, perform a slow-speed rotational check per machine HMI and verify spindle runout and bearing condition in accordance with SOP-P1-L1-05.

Acceptance criteria
- All chuck jaw bolts are torqued to 100 N·m and retain specified torque on verification readback.
- Spindle has completed a continuous warm-up period equal to 21 minutes prior to loading. No abnormal noise, vibration, or alarms were observed during warm-up.
- Machine is returned to operation only if inspections meet criteria in SOP-P1-L1-03, SOP-P1-L1-04, and SOP-P1-L1-05. Any deviation requires corrective action and documentation in the maintenance log.
title: Maintenance manual - Hot Forge CNC turning center #2

text:
# MM-P1-L1-IH03 - Maintenance manual - Hot Forge induction billet heater #3

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-IH03

Scope
- This document covers routine maintenance and verification steps for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03). Tasks address mechanical inspection, cooling system verification, and temperature control checks required to maintain process readiness.

Tools
- Torque wrench set appropriate for manufacturer fasteners.
- Digital infrared pyrometer or contact thermocouple calibrated for process use.
- Flow meter capable of verifying coil cooling water flow.
- Insulation-resistant gloves and eye protection.
- Lockout-tagout kit and multimeter for electrical isolation verification.

Procedure
- Verify equipment is placed into maintenance lockout in accordance with SOP-P1-L1-01 before any work on EQ-P1-L1-IH03. Confirm electrical isolation and test for zero energy.
- Visually inspect coil assembly, bus connections, and water lines for leaks, wear, and securing hardware. Repair or replace per OEM guidance.
- Restart cooling water to the coil and use the flow meter to confirm coil cooling water flow meets the coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 72 L/min. Do not proceed if flow is below this value; rectify leaks, filter restrictions, or pump issues.
- Power unit under maintenance-mode procedures from SOP-P1-L1-01 and bring to idle according to control interface. Using the pyrometer or thermocouple, heat a dummy billet and monitor temperature until the target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 1180 °C. Verify stability and repeatability of temperature control.
- Re-secure all covers and verify electrical connections meet insulation and fastening requirements per SB-1009. Remove lockout when maintenance is complete and document actions.

Acceptance criteria
- Coil cooling water flow is confirmed at or above 72 L/min.
- Temperature control achieves and maintains 1180 °C on the billet within control tolerances.
- No fluid leaks, loose connections, or safety impediments remain; all work documented in MM-P1-L1-IH03-S3 and SOP-P1-L1-01.
title: Maintenance manual - Hot Forge induction billet heater #3

# MM-P1-L2-RR01 - Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01

## Scope
This document defines required maintenance tasks for EQ-P1-L2-RR01 ring rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 at P1, line P1-L2. It covers routine mechanical checks, mandrel clamp bolt verification, and main roll bearing lubrication scheduling. Refer to ECN-2026-041 for engineering changes and to SOP-P1-L2-01 and SOP-P1-L2-04 for related operational procedures.

## Tools
- Torque wrench suitable for specified torque
- Grease gun compatible with the machine ports
- Inspection flashlight and mirror
- Clean lint-free rags and approved grease

## Procedure
- Prepare the machine following SOP-P1-L2-01 and lockout/tagout requirements in SOP-P1-L2-04.
- Inspect mandrel clamp assembly for wear, cracks, and secure fit. Clean contact surfaces and remove debris.
- Set torque wrench to the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 395 N·m and tighten bolts in alternating sequence to ensure uniform clamping. Verify each bolt reaches the specified setting.
- Check main roll bearings for lubricant condition and contamination. If grease appears dark or contains debris, purge and re-lubricate according to this document.
- Apply grease to main roll bearings and machine lubrication points using the grease gun. Adhere to the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 145 hours and log each lubrication event in the maintenance record.
- Perform a functional run according to SOP-P1-L2-01 to confirm normal operation and absence of unusual noise or vibration.

## Acceptance criteria
- All mandrel clamp bolts are torqued to the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 395 N·m and documented.
- Main roll bearings show proper lubricant presence, and lubrication events match the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 145 hours in maintenance logs.
- No abnormal noise, vibration, or leakage observed during post-maintenance functional run.
- Any deviations or repairs captured and processed per ECN-2026-041.

text:
# MM-P1-L2-IH02 - Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2
Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-IH02

Scope
This document covers preventive maintenance and inspection tasks for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02). Activities focus on electrical, cooling, and process-control elements required to support safe operation and product quality. Refer to QS-PROC-02, SOP-P1-L2-02, SOP-P1-L2-04 for process and quality controls.

Tools
- Multimeter and insulation tester
- Flow meter or portable flow verification device
- Thermal pyrometer or calibrated temperature measurement device
- Basic hand tools and non-sparking inspection mirror
- PPE per SOP-P1-L2-02

Procedure
1. Lockout/tagout per SOP-P1-L2-02. Verify isolation of power and interlocks before opening panels.  
2. Visual inspection: check coil and busbar insulation, look for discoloration, cracking, or loose connections. Record findings in the maintenance log.  
3. Cooling system: inspect inlet/outlet hoses and fittings for wear or leaks. Measure coil cooling water flow and verify the coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 46 L/min. Document flow readings and corrective actions if below the minimum.  
4. Controls and sensors: verify sensor wiring integrity and controller status. Calibrate temperature sensors following manufacturer guidance. Use a thermal pyrometer to confirm process response during a controlled heat cycle.  
5. Heat verification: perform a monitored heat to validate power delivery and temperature control. Confirm the target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 1230 °C using calibrated instrumentation. Record the measured temperature trace and any deviations.  
6. Reassemble panels, remove lockout/tagout, and return equipment to service per SOP-P1-L2-04.

Acceptance criteria
- No visible damage to coils or busbars that would compromise safe operation.  
- Coil cooling water flow meets or exceeds the coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 46 L/min.  
- Measured billet temperature reaches the target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 1230 °C within normal control response.  
- All findings and corrective actions documented and filed per QS-PROC-02.
title: Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2

# MM-P1-L2-HT03 - Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-HT03

Scope
- This document defines required maintenance tasks, verification steps, and acceptance criteria for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03). Tasks cover routine inspection, sensor verification, and basic corrective actions necessary to maintain safe and repeatable heat treat cycles. See related operating procedures SOP-P1-L2-01, SOP-P1-L2-04, SOP-P1-L2-05.

Tools
- Digital handheld multimeter with temperature input compatible with thermocouple type installed.
- Calibrated reference thermocouple probe and connector compatible with furnace junction.
- Insulated gloves and face protection rated for heat treat operations.
- Basic hand tools and non-marring adjustment tools as required by mechanical fasteners.

Procedure
- Lock out and tag out per local procedures referenced in SOP-P1-L2-01 before any inspection or sensor removal.
- Verify controller configuration and note setpoints. The austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 855 °C.
- Remove thermocouple junction access panel and visually inspect wiring for damage or corrosion. Replace damaged wiring using approved parts in coordination with maintenance supervision.
- Perform thermocouple verification using the calibrated reference probe. Follow manufacturer guidance for insertion depth and thermal stabilization prior to recording readings.
- Record verification readings and compare to controller display. Adjust sensor position or replace thermocouple per findings.
- Return access panels and restore energy. Execute a controlled heat check cycle per SOP-P1-L2-04 to confirm stability.

Acceptance criteria
- Thermocouple calibration results fall within manufacturer tolerance when compared to the calibrated reference probe. The thermocouple calibration interval for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 95 days. Records shall show completion and results in the maintenance log referenced in SOP-P1-L2-05.
- Controller reaches and stabilizes at the austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 855 °C within expected control behavior and without alarm conditions.
- No visible damage or foreign material present in the combustion and control compartments after maintenance.
title: Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3

# MM-P1-L3-HP02 Maintenance manual - Machining hydraulic forging press #2

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-HP02

Scope
This document defines required maintenance actions for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) to ensure safe operation and consistent production performance. Routine mechanical and hydraulic checks described here are mandatory for maintenance personnel assigned to P1-L3. Refer to ECN-2026-035 for design change history and to SOP-P1-L3-03 and SOP-P1-L3-04 for operator-level safety and lockout procedures.

Tools
- Standard hydraulic service toolset and calibrated torque wrench capable of achieving specified torque values.  
- Pressure gauge and test coupling compatible with the press hydraulic interface.  
- Lifting and alignment fixtures as required by factory handling procedures.

Procedure
- Verify lockout and tagout per SOP-P1-L3-03 before accessing hydraulic components.  
- Inspect visible hydraulic lines and fittings for abrasion, chafing, or leakage; repair per ECN-2026-035 guidance if defects are found.  
- With system drained and isolated, confirm main ram hardware condition. Replace fasteners that show permanent distortion or thread damage.  
- When reassembling the main ram flange, apply the specified torque. The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is 1330 N·m. Use a calibrated torque wrench and follow controlled tightening sequence to the specified value.  
- Refill and purge the hydraulic system according to manufacturer procedures. Prior to load testing, confirm hydraulic supply meets the permitted operating limits. The system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is 295 bar.  
- Conduct functional checks per SOP-P1-L3-04 and document results in maintenance records.

Acceptance criteria
- No visible leakage from repaired or replaced hydraulic components under the permitted system pressure.  
- Main ram bolts remain tight at the specified torque after first operational cycle. The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is 1330 N·m.  
- System operates without pressure excursions beyond the system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is 295 bar.  
- All work documented and cross-referenced with ECN-2026-035, SOP-P1-L3-03, and SOP-P1-L3-04.

# MM-P1-L3-CN03 - Maintenance manual - Machining CNC turning center #3

Scope
- Preventive maintenance and basic corrective tasks for EQ-P1-L3-CN03.

- General safety: verify lockout/tagout per SOP-P1-L3-01 before maintenance.

Monitor for unusual vibration or noise; record observations in the maintenance log.  
- Chuck jaw bolt torque: when servicing the chuck, clean mating surfaces, install jaw bolts, and apply final torque. The chuck jaw bolt torque for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) is 95 N·m. Use calibrated torque wrench and follow tightening pattern recommended in MM-P1-L3-CN03-S1.
